recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a future generator or profile source reintroduces root sliceName in generated SimpleQuantity output; the existing negative invariant test fixture should remain.
issue_request: FHIR-13740 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core datatypes issue reporting that the SimpleQuantity definition generated from profiles-types.xml placed sliceName=SimpleQuantity on the root Quantity element. The approved resolution was to fix code so that sliceName did not propagate into the resource representation.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 12619. The matching git-svn commit de70b2e64f1ced835648f041b70749a2495e271b, '#13740 - remove bogus slice name,' commented out e.setSliceName(pt.getName()) in the old ProfileGenerator.java root element construction. That historical generator path is not present in the current checkout.
additional_context: SimpleQuantity remains active and normative in source/fhir.ini and is generated from the current Quantity restriction source, which only constrains comparator.empty() and has no sliceName source field. Later/current root-sliceName handling is covered by ElementDefinition guidance and StructureDefinition invariant sdf-23, and related audits for FHIR-12849 and FHIR-13400 are already on the combined branch. The only root sliceName found in current source is a deliberate failing sdf-23 invariant test fixture.
reconciliation: No source change was necessary. Current build-scope source prohibits root sliceName, the active SimpleQuantity source does not encode one, and the current generated SimpleQuantity XML on build.fhir.org has zero sliceName elements.
